name: Docker Sandboxes (sbx)
description: OpenClaw sandbox backend that runs agent exec and file tools inside Docker Sandboxes (sbx) microVMs, each with its own kernel and Docker engine.

command.label: sbx command
command.help: Path or name of the sbx CLI.

agent.label: Agent or kit
agent.help: sbx agent name or kit reference used at create time. "shell" is a plain exec sandbox.

cpus.label: CPUs
cpus.help: CPUs per sandbox (--cpus). Default: sbx decides.

staticMcp.label: Static MCP servers
staticMcp.help: sbx MCP gateway server names fixed at create time (--static-mcp).

workspaceMode.label: Workspace mode
workspaceMode.help: mount: bind-mount the workspace read-write (changes land on the host immediately). clone: the agent works on a private clone inside the VM and the host repo is read-only; fetch results with git. Needs a git repository.

transport.label: Transport
transport.help: exec: run commands and file operations through `sbx exec` (default). ssh: run them over SSH through the sbx SSH endpoint using OpenClaw's SSH sandbox helpers (needs ssh on the gateway host; no `sbx setup ssh` required).

sshCommand.label: ssh command
sshCommand.help: ssh client used by the ssh transport.

sshControlPersistSeconds.label: SSH connection reuse (s)
sshControlPersistSeconds.help: ssh transport: keep one multiplexed ssh connection per sandbox open this many seconds after last use (0 disables reuse).

timeoutSeconds.label: Command timeout (s)
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for sbx management calls such as create.
